t: A physical education game where students act as spy agents that learn from rewards.
steps: Find the paper on NSF PAR by searching for the Temple SIGCSE 2023 reinforcement learning PE activity.
Read Figure 1, which gives a sample two-state example.
Set out two or more cones as stations.
Define the moves and give each one a point value.
Decide which moves lead to which station.
Announce the destination station and the points to students.
Let students replay and revise their sequences to earn the most points.
